words.note: Starts a sentence: 'so/then'. Not 咁 gam3 'so (very)'.

ex.r: gam2 ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 gin3 laa1
ex.en: Then let's meet tomorrow.

ex.r: gam2 ngo5 maai5 ni1 gin6 laa1
ex.en: Then I'll buy this one.

ex.r: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2 laa1
ex.en: Don't talk like that.

words.note: As 'this' (呢個) it is read ni1.

ex.r: ngo5 gei2 hou2 aa3 nei5 ne1
ex.en: I'm pretty good, and you?

ex.r: ngo5 ge3 so2 si4 ne1
ex.en: Where are my keys?

ex.r: gam1 maan5 sik6 me1 hou2 ne1
ex.en: What should we eat tonight?

ex.r: ngo5 dou1 soeng2 heoi3
ex.en: I want to go too.

ex.r: keoi5 dei6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 ji1 sang1
ex.en: They're all doctors.

ex.r: ngo5 jat1 di1 dou1 m4 gui6
ex.en: I'm not tired at all.

words.note: Adds 'you know' emphasis; in questions sounds surprised or checking.

ex.r: ni1 dou6 di1 je5 hou2 gwai3 gaa3
ex.en: Things here are really expensive, you know.

ex.r: nei5 dim2 gaai2 wui5 hai2 dou6 gaa3
ex.en: Why are you here?

ex.r: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 lou5 po4 lai4 gaa3
ex.en: She's my wife.

words.note: Spoken 'not'; Mandarin 不 isn't used in speech.

ex.r: ngo5 m4 sik6 laat6
ex.en: I don't eat spicy food.

ex.r: m4 goi1 ngo5 m4 jiu3 doi2
ex.en: No bag for me, thanks.

ex.r: gam1 jat6 hou2 dung3 ngo5 m4 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1
ex.en: It's cold today, I don't want to go out.

words.note: Softens requests and suggestions.

ex.r: faai3 di1 laa1 zau6 lai4 ci4 dou3 laa3
ex.en: Hurry up, we're about to be late!

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jam2 caa4 laa1
ex.en: Let's go for dim sum.

ex.s: 你坐低先啦，我好快返嚟。
ex.r: nei5 co5 dai1 sin1 laa1 ngo5 hou2 faai3 faan1 lai4
ex.en: Have a seat, I'll be right back.

words.note: Most common measure word; 個 + noun can also mean 'the'.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 jat1 go3 hon3 bou2 baau1
ex.en: I'd like a hamburger.

ex.s: 個天好黑呀，就快落雨喇。
ex.r: go3 tin1 hou2 hak1 aa3 zau6 faai3 lok6 jyu5 laa3
ex.en: The sky's really dark, it's about to rain.

ex.r: keoi5 jau5 loeng5 go3 zai2
ex.en: He has two sons.

ex.r: ngo5 jau5 jat1 go3 sai3 lou2
ex.en: I have a younger brother.

ex.r: ni1 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 caan1 teng1
ex.en: There are lots of restaurants here.

ex.r: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jau5 si4 gaan3
ex.en: I have time tomorrow.

words.note: Plural/uncountable measure word; after an adjective = 'a bit more': 快啲.

ex.r: di1 sung3 hou2 hou2 sik6
ex.en: The dishes are really tasty.

ex.r: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 maan6 di1 aa3
ex.en: Could you speak a bit slower?

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 di1 saang1 gwo2
ex.en: I want to buy some fruit.

words.note: 又…又… = both…and….

ex.r: nei5 jau6 ci4 dou3 laa3
ex.en: You're late again!

ex.r: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jau6 peng4 jau6 hou2 sik6
ex.en: This restaurant is cheap and tasty.

ex.r: gam1 jat6 jau6 lok6 jyu5
ex.en: It's raining again today.

words.note: 話 + person + 知 = tell someone. In 電話 it's waa2.

ex.r: waa6 keoi5 gam1 maan5 m4 faan1 lai4 sik6 faan6
ex.en: Mei said she won't be home for dinner tonight.

ex.r: ngo5 waa6 zo2 bei2 nei5 zi1 gaa3 laa3
ex.en: I already told you.

ex.r: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 jiu3 jau1 sik1 gei2 jat6
ex.en: The doctor said I need to rest a few days.

words.note: Marks a completed action; replaces Mandarin 了.

ex.r: nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Have you eaten yet?

ex.r: ngo5 maai5 zo2 bou6 san1 sau2 gei1
ex.en: I bought a new phone.

ex.r: keoi5 ji5 ging1 faan1 zo2 uk1 kei2 laa3
ex.en: He's already gone home.

words.en: to not have; there isn't; didn't
words.note: Negative of 有; replaces Mandarin 沒有. Before a verb: 'didn't'.

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 go3 jyut6 mou5 mat1 cin2
ex.en: I don't have much money this month.

ex.r: syut3 gwai6 mou5 ngau4 naai5 laa3
ex.en: There's no milk left in the fridge.

ex.r: ngo5 cam4 maan5 mou5 fan3 hou2
ex.en: I didn't sleep well last night.

ex.r: ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5
ex.en: It's going to rain tomorrow.

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 maan5 wui5 maan5 di1 faan1
ex.en: I'll be home a bit late tonight.

ex.r: nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 gong2 jing1 man2
ex.en: Can you speak English?

words.note: Measure word: 個.

ex.r: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 do1 jan4
ex.en: This restaurant is really crowded.

ex.r: keoi5 hai6 go3 hou2 jan4
ex.en: He's a good person.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jau5 ng5 sap6 go3 jan4
ex.en: Our company has fifty people.

ex.r: nei5 heoi3 bin1 aa3
ex.en: Where are you going?

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 ciu1 si5 maai5 je5
ex.en: We're going to the supermarket tomorrow.

ex.r: ngo5 hou2 soeng2 heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4
ex.en: I really want to travel to Japan.

words.note: Marks something new: 'now, already'. 夠喇 = that's enough.

ex.r: sik6 faan6 laa3 faai3 di1 lai4
ex.en: Dinner's ready, come quickly!

ex.r: ngo5 baau2 laa3 m4 goi1
ex.en: I'm full now, thanks.

ex.r: ngo5 jiu3 zau2 laa3 ting1 jat6 gin3
ex.en: I have to go now, see you tomorrow.

words.note: Gives an obvious reason: 'after all, you know'.

ex.r: ngo5 m4 heoi3 laa3 lok6 gan2 jyu5 maa3
ex.en: I'm not going, it's raining after all.

ex.r: keoi5 hou2 gui6 zou6 zo2 jat1 jat6 je5 maa3
ex.en: He's tired, he worked all day, you know.

ex.r: peng4 di1 laa1 ngo5 maai5 loeng5 gin6 maa3
ex.en: Make it cheaper, I'm buying two after all.

words.en: to speak; to talk; to say
words.note: 講 + language = speak it; 同…講 = tell/talk to.

ex.r: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 faai3
ex.en: She talks really fast.

ex.r: ngo5 tung4 lou5 baan2 gong2 zo2
ex.en: I talked to the boss.

ex.r: sik1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2
ex.en: Diego can speak Cantonese.

words.note: Often shortened to 咩 me1. Mandarin 什麼.

ex.r: nei5 soeng2 sik6 mat1 je5 aa3
ex.en: What do you want to eat?

ex.r: nei5 zou6 mat1 je5 gung1 gaa3
ex.en: What do you do for work?

ex.r: faat3 sang1 mat1 je5 si6
ex.en: What happened?

words.note: 買嘢 shop, 食嘢 eat, 做嘢 work. Replaces Mandarin 東西.

ex.r: ngo5 heoi3 maai5 di1 je5
ex.en: I'm going to buy some stuff.

ex.r: nei5 sik6 zo2 je5 mei6
ex.en: Have you eaten anything?

ex.r: ngo5 zung6 zou6 gan2 je5
ex.en: I'm still working.

ex.r: nei5 gok3 dak1 dim2 aa3
ex.en: What do you think?

ex.r: ngo5 gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 m4 syu1 fuk6
ex.en: I feel a bit unwell.

ex.r: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 leng3
ex.en: I think this shirt is really nice.

words.note: 唔知 = don't know. For knowing people or skills use 識.

ex.r: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 gei2 dim2 dou3
ex.en: I don't know what time he arrives.

ex.r: nei5 zi1 m4 zi1 sai2 sau2 gaan1 hai2 bin1
ex.en: Do you know where the restroom is?

ex.r: ngo5 zi1 nei5 hou2 mong4
ex.en: I know you're very busy.

words.en: to do; to make; to work
words.note: 做嘢 = to work.

ex.r: nei5 gam1 maan5 zou6 me1 aa3
ex.en: What are you doing tonight?

ex.r: ngo5 hai2 ji1 jyun2 zou6 je5
ex.en: I work at a hospital.

ex.r: ngo5 maa4 maa1 hou2 zung1 ji3 zou6 daan6 gou1
ex.en: My mom loves making cakes.

words.note: Result marker: 搵到 found, 見到 saw. As 'arrive' it is dou3.

ex.r: ngo5 wan2 dou2 ngo5 go3 ngan4 baau1 laa3
ex.en: I found my wallet!

ex.r: nei5 teng1 m4 teng1 dou2 ngo5 gong2 je5
ex.en: Can you hear me?

ex.s: 我尋日喺超市見到你老公。
ex.r: ngo5 cam4 jat6 hai2 ciu1 si5 gin3 dou2 nei5 lou5 gung1
ex.en: I saw your husband at the supermarket yesterday.

words.note: Colloquial 'come' (Mandarin 來); many speakers say lei4.

ex.r: nei5 gei2 dim2 lai4 aa3
ex.en: What time are you coming?

ex.r: gwo3 lai4 sik6 faan6 laa1
ex.en: Come over and eat!

ex.r: faai3 di1 gaa3 baa1 si2 lai4 laa3
ex.en: Quick, the bus is coming!

words.note: 幾 + adjective = 'quite'; 幾點 = what time.

ex.r: ji4 gaa1 gei2 dim2 aa3
ex.en: What time is it now?

ex.r: ni1 dou6 di1 je5 gei2 hou2 sik6
ex.en: The food here is pretty good.

ex.r: ngo5 heoi3 zo2 toi4 waan1 gei2 jat6
ex.en: I went to Taiwan for a few days.

words.note: Needs a measure word: 嗰個, 嗰間. Mandarin 那.

ex.r: go2 go3 jan4 hai6 bin1 go3 aa3
ex.en: Who's that person?

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 go2 gin6 m4 goi1
ex.en: I'd like that one, please.

ex.r: go2 gaan1 hok6 haau6 hou2 kan5 ngo5 uk1 kei2
ex.en: That school is really close to my home.

ex.s: 其實我唔係好鍾意食魚。
ex.r: kei4 sat6 ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 jyu2
ex.en: Actually, I don't really like fish.

ex.r: kei4 sat6 keoi5 jan4 gei2 hou2 gaa3
ex.en: Actually, he's quite a nice person.

ex.r: kei4 sat6 m4 sai2 gam3 zou2 ceot1 mun4
ex.en: Actually, we don't need to leave so early.

words.note: 去過 = have been. Also a verb: 'to cross, pass'.

ex.r: nei5 heoi3 gwo3 jat6 bun2 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Have you been to Japan?

ex.r: ngo5 mei6 si3 gwo3 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1
ex.en: I've never tried this restaurant.

ex.r: ngo5 hok6 gwo3 gei2 nin4 gong3 kam4
ex.en: I studied piano for a few years.

words.note: Very common softener; aa4 in surprised or checking questions.

ex.r: nei5 giu3 me1 meng2 aa3
ex.en: What's your name?

ex.s: 今日好凍呀，著多件衫啦。
ex.r: gam1 jat6 hou2 dung3 aa3 zoek3 do1 gin6 saam1 laa1
ex.en: It's so cold today, put on another layer.

ex.r: ni1 go3 gei2 cin2 aa3
ex.en: How much is this?

words.note: After a verb: 食多啲 = eat more.

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 zou6
ex.en: I have lots to do today.

ex.r: nei5 jiu3 sik6 do1 di1 coi3
ex.en: You need to eat more vegetables.

ex.r: go2 dou6 do1 m4 do1 jan4 aa3
ex.en: Is it crowded there?

words.note: Colloquial 'think'; 諗住 = plan to.

ex.r: dang2 ngo5 nam2 haa5 sin1
ex.en: Let me think about it first.

ex.r: ngo5 nam2 keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 wui5 lai4
ex.en: I don't think he'll come today.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 nam2 zyu6 syu2 gaa3 heoi3 leoi5 hang4
ex.en: We're planning to travel in the summer holidays.

words.note: 點樣 = how; 點解 = why; 幾點 = what time.

ex.r: nei5 dim2 faan1 uk1 kei2 aa3
ex.en: How are you getting home?

ex.r: ni1 go3 zi6 dim2 duk6 aa3
ex.en: How do you pronounce this word?

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 cat1 dim2 hai2 mun4 hau2 dang2
ex.en: We'll wait at the entrance at seven.

ex.r: ngo5 zi6 gei2 lai4 dak1 laa3 m4 goi1
ex.en: I can do it myself, thanks.

ex.r: nei5 jiu3 ziu3 gu3 hou2 zi6 gei2
ex.en: Take good care of yourself.

ex.r: keoi5 zi6 gei2 jat1 go3 jan4 zyu6
ex.en: She lives by herself.

words.note: Joins nouns or adds a point. Mandarin 和.

ex.s: 我要一個菠蘿包同埋一杯奶茶。
ex.r: ngo5 jiu3 jat1 go3 bo1 lo4 baau1 tung4 maai4 jat1 bui1 naai5 caa4
ex.en: I'd like a pineapple bun and a milk tea.

ex.r: gei3 dak1 daai3 ngan4 baau1 tung4 maai4 so2 si4
ex.en: Remember to bring your wallet and keys.

ex.s: 佢識講英文同埋廣東話。
ex.r: keoi5 sik1 gong2 jing1 man2 tung4 maai4 gwong2 dung1 waa2
ex.en: She speaks English and Cantonese.

ex.r: sin1 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 gan1 zyu6 heoi3 ciu1 si5
ex.en: First the bank, then the supermarket.

ex.s: 我哋食完飯，跟住去睇戲。
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 sik6 jyun4 faan6 gan1 zyu6 heoi3 tai2 hei3
ex.en: We'll eat, then go see a movie.

ex.r: haang4 dou3 mei5 gan1 zyu6 zyun3 zo2
ex.en: Walk to the end, then turn left.

ex.r: ho2 nang4 sak1 gan2 ce1
ex.en: Kevin might be stuck in traffic.

ex.r: gam1 maan5 ho2 nang4 wui5 lok6 jyu5
ex.en: It might rain tonight.

ex.r: ngo5 ho2 nang4 jiu3 gaa1 baan1
ex.en: I might have to work overtime.

words.note: Marks the receiver; also 'let'. Also written 畀.

ex.r: m4 goi1 bei2 bui1 seoi2 ngo5
ex.en: A glass of water, please.

ex.r: ni1 fan6 lai5 mat6 hai6 bei2 nei5 ge3
ex.en: This gift is for you.

ex.r: gam1 ci3 ngo5 bei2 cin2 haa6 ci3 nei5 ceng2
ex.en: I'll pay this time, you treat next time.

words.note: 食晒 = ate it all; 多謝晒 = thanks a lot.

ex.r: nei5 sik6 saai3 di1 faan6 sin1 laa1
ex.en: Finish your rice first.

ex.r: di1 fei1 maai6 saai3 laa3
ex.en: The tickets are all sold out.

ex.r: do1 ze6 saai3 nei5 bong1 ngo5
ex.en: Thanks so much for helping me.

words.en: to look for; to find; to contact
words.note: Colloquial 'look for' (Mandarin 找); 搵到 = found.

ex.r: ngo5 wan2 gan2 ngo5 bou6 sau2 gei1
ex.en: I'm looking for my phone.

ex.r: jau5 si6 zau6 wan2 ngo5 laa1
ex.en: If anything comes up, contact me.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 wan2 di1 je5 sik6
ex.en: Let's go find something to eat.

words.en: to return; go back; (after verb) back
words.note: 返工 go to work, 返學 go to school, 還返 give back.

ex.r: ngo5 baat3 dim2 faan1 gung1
ex.en: I go to work at eight.

ex.r: siu2 pang4 jau5 ting1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 hok6
ex.en: The kids don't have school tomorrow.

ex.r: gei3 dak1 waan4 faan1 bun2 syu1 bei2 ngo5
ex.en: Remember to give my book back.

words.note: V咗…未？ = 'have you…yet?'; answer 未呀 = not yet.

ex.r: nei5 zou6 jyun4 gung1 fo3 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Have you finished your homework yet?

ex.r: zung6 mei6 dou3
ex.en: Wei hasn't arrived yet.

ex.r: ngo5 mei6 sik6 zou2 caan1
ex.en: I haven't had breakfast yet.

words.en: at that time; back then; when
words.note: Often shortened to 嗰陣.

ex.s: 我細個嗰陣時住喺九龍。
ex.r: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4 zyu6 hai2 gau2 lung4
ex.en: When I was little I lived in Kowloon.

ex.r: go2 zan6 si4 ngo5 zung6 duk6 gan2 daai6 hok6
ex.en: Back then I was still in university.

ex.s: 我打俾你嗰陣時，你喺邊呀？
ex.r: ngo5 daa2 bei2 nei5 go2 zan6 si4 nei5 hai2 bin1 aa3
ex.en: Where were you when I called you?

ex.r: nei5 jing1 goi1 zou2 di1 fan3
ex.en: You should go to bed earlier.

ex.r: keoi5 jing1 goi1 dou3 zo2 laa3
ex.en: She should have arrived by now.

ex.s: 我哋應該俾幾多貼士呀？
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 bei2 gei2 do1 tip1 si2 aa3
ex.en: How much should we tip?

words.note: Said teng1 in speech; but 聽日 'tomorrow' is ting1 jat6.

ex.r: nei5 zung1 m4 zung1 ji3 teng1 jam1 ngok6 aa3
ex.en: Do you like listening to music?

ex.s: 我聽唔清楚，你大聲啲得唔得？
ex.r: ngo5 teng1 m4 cing1 co2 nei5 daai6 seng1 di1 dak1 m4 dak1
ex.en: I can't hear clearly, could you speak louder?

ex.r: nei5 jiu3 teng1 ji1 sang1 gong2
ex.en: You have to listen to the doctor.

words.note: Plural of 呢個; also for uncountables like water or food.

ex.r: ni1 di1 hai6 mat1 je5 lai4 gaa3
ex.en: What are these?

ex.r: ni1 di1 saam1 jiu3 sai2
ex.en: These clothes need washing.

ex.r: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 ni1 di1
ex.en: I don't like eating this stuff.

words.note: 見到 = saw. For 'look at, watch' use 睇.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 sing1 kei4 luk6 gin3 laa1
ex.en: Let's meet on Saturday.

ex.r: ngo5 hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3 gwo3 keoi5
ex.en: I haven't seen him for a long time.

ex.r: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 gin3 ji1 sang1
ex.en: I have to see the doctor tomorrow.

words.en: is there…?; do you have…?; did you…?
words.note: Yes/no question; answer 有 (yes) or 冇 (no).

ex.r: nei5 jau5 mou5 hing1 dai6 zi2 mui6 aa3
ex.en: Do you have any siblings?

ex.r: fu6 gan6 jau5 mou5 sai2 sau2 gaan1
ex.en: Is there a restroom nearby?

ex.r: ni1 gin6 jau5 mou5 sai3 maa5
ex.en: Do you have this in a small size?

words.note: 'Or' in statements; in questions use 定係.

ex.s: 你可以搭地鐵或者巴士。
ex.r: nei5 ho2 ji5 daap3 dei6 tit3 waak6 ze2 baa1 si2
ex.en: You can take the MTR or the bus.

ex.r: waak6 ze2 ngo5 dei6 goi2 jat6 zoi3 king1
ex.en: Maybe we can talk another day.

ex.s: 星期六或者星期日都得。
ex.r: sing1 kei4 luk6 waak6 ze2 sing1 kei4 jat6 dou1 dak1
ex.en: Saturday or Sunday are both fine.

words.note: Used directly with numbers, no measure word: 三年.

ex.r: ngo5 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 zyu6 zo2 saam1 nin4
ex.en: I've lived in Hong Kong for three years.

ex.s: 我哋每年都返去探屋企人。
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 mui5 nin4 dou1 faan1 heoi3 taam3 uk1 kei2 jan4
ex.en: We go back every year to visit family.

ex.r: ngo5 zou6 zo2 ni1 fan6 gung1 loeng5 nin4
ex.en: I've had this job for two years.

words.note: 一隻狗 a dog; 隻手 the hand.

ex.r: ngo5 uk1 kei2 jau5 zek3 gau2
ex.en: We have a dog at home.

ex.r: ngo5 zek3 goek3 hou2 tung3
ex.en: My foot really hurts.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 giu3 bun3 zek3 gai1 laa1
ex.en: Let's order half a chicken.

words.note: Said cin2 when it means money; 幾錢 = how much?

ex.s: 呢件衫好抵，唔使好多錢。
ex.r: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 dai2 m4 sai2 hou2 do1 cin2
ex.en: This shirt's a good deal, it doesn't cost much.

ex.r: maai4 daan1 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3
ex.en: How much is the bill?

ex.r: soeng2 cyu5 cin2 maai5 lau2
ex.en: Sofía wants to save money to buy a flat.

words.note: 我想問吓 = 'excuse me, may I ask'.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 man6 haa5 dei6 tit3 zaam6 hai2 bin1
ex.en: Excuse me, where's the MTR station?

ex.r: nei5 jau5 man6 tai4 ho2 ji5 man6 lou5 si1
ex.en: If you have questions, you can ask the teacher.

ex.r: maa4 maa1 man6 nei5 gei2 si4 faan1 lai4
ex.en: Mom's asking when you're coming back.

words.note: Also written 中意. 好鍾意 = really like.

ex.r: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 dim2 sam1
ex.en: I really love dim sum.

ex.r: nei5 zung1 ji3 zou6 me1 wan6 dung6
ex.en: What sports do you like?

ex.r: keoi5 m4 zung1 ji3 lok6 jyu5 tin1
ex.en: She doesn't like rainy days.

words.note: With numbers, no measure word: 三日. 今日 today.

ex.s: 今日好熱呀，記得飲多啲水。
ex.r: gam1 jat6 hou2 jit6 aa3 gei3 dak1 jam2 do1 di1 seoi2
ex.en: It's so hot today, remember to drink more water.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 hai2 dung1 ging1 zyu6 zo2 ng5 jat6
ex.en: We stayed in Tokyo for five days.

ex.r: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 haang4 bun3 go3 zung1
ex.en: I walk for half an hour every day.

words.note: Before a verb: doing it right now, e.g. 佢喺度食飯.

ex.r: ngo5 hai2 dou6 dang2 nei5
ex.en: I'm waiting for you here.

ex.r: keoi5 m4 hai2 dou6 ceot1 zo2 heoi3

ex.en: My score was low this time.

ex.en: She travels all over on her holidays.

ex.r: uk1 kei2 zau1 wai4 jau5 hou2 do1 caan1 teng1
ex.en: There are lots of restaurants around my home.

words.note: Measure word 部.

ex.r: ngo5 bou6 din6 nou5 hou2 maan6
ex.en: My computer is really slow.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 bou6 san1 din6 nou5
ex.en: I want to buy a new computer.

ex.en: Mom, I'm home!

ex.en: The dishes my mom cooks are delicious.

ex.en: Her daughter starts university this year.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 hai6 daai6 hok6 tung4 hok6
ex.en: We were college classmates.

ex.r: heoi3 dou3 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 ngo5

ex.r: daap3 dei6 tit3 sap6 fan1 zung1 zau6 heoi3 dou3
ex.en: It's only ten minutes by subway.

words.note: 外國人 = foreigner.

ex.en: She's studying abroad.

ex.en: This is imported chocolate.

ex.r: ngo5 m4 gam2 jat1 go3 jan4 tai2 hung2 bou3 pin2
ex.en: I don't dare watch horror movies alone.

ex.r: nei5 gam2 m4 gam2 sik6 lau4 lin4
ex.en: Do you dare eat durian?

ex.r: keoi5 m4 gam2 tung4 lou5 sai3 gong2
ex.en: He doesn't dare tell the boss.

words.note: Cantonese 'cute'; not 'proud' as in Mandarin.

ex.r: nei5 zek3 maau1 hou2 dak1 ji3 aa3
ex.en: Your cat is so cute!

ex.s: 呢個杯好得意，買咗佢啦。
ex.r: ni1 go3 bui1 hou2 dak1 ji3 maai5 zo2 keoi5 laa1
ex.en: This cup is so cute, let's buy it.

ex.r: keoi5 go3 neoi2 siu3 hei2 lai4 hou2 dak1 ji3
ex.en: Her daughter is adorable when she laughs.

words.note: Often 除咗…之外. With 都 = except; with 仲 = besides.

ex.r: ceoi4 zo2 ngo5 go3 go3 dou1 heoi3
ex.en: Everyone's going except me.

ex.r: ceoi4 zo2 jyun4 seoi1 ngo5 mat1 dou1 sik6
ex.en: I eat everything except cilantro.

ex.r: ceoi4 zo2 zung1 man2 keoi5 zung6 sik1 gong2 jat6 man2
ex.en: Besides Chinese, she also speaks Japanese.

words.note: 對…有興趣 = be interested in…

ex.r: nei5 jau5 me1 hing3 ceoi3 aa3
ex.en: What are your hobbies?

ex.r: ngo5 deoi3 zyu2 je5 sik6 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3
ex.en: I'm really interested in cooking.

ex.r: go2 fan6 gung1 ngo5 mou5 mat1 hing3 ceoi3
ex.en: I'm not very interested in that job.

ex.r: ni1 tou3 hei3 hou2 gaau2 siu3
ex.en: This movie is hilarious.

ex.r: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 gaau2 siu3
ex.en: He's a really funny guy.

ex.r: nei5 gaau2 siu3 me1 gam3 gwai3
ex.en: Are you kidding? That expensive!

words.note: 出街 = go out. Measure word 條.

ex.r: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 jau5 hou2 do1 siu2 sik6
ex.en: This street has lots of snacks.

ex.en: The street is quiet at night.

ex.r: gwo3 gaai1 jiu3 tai2 ce1 aa3
ex.en: Watch for cars when you cross the street.

ex.r: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 fei4 zo2
ex.en: I've gained weight lately.

ex.r: nei5 zek3 maau1 hou2 fei4 aa3
ex.en: Your cat is so fat!

ex.r: ni1 faai3 juk6 taai3 fei4 laa3
ex.en: This piece of meat is too fatty.

ex.r: ngo5 sai3 go3 zyu6 hai2 gau2 lung4
ex.en: I lived in Kowloon when I was little.

ex.r: keoi5 sai3 go3 hou2 zung1 ji3 jau4 seoi2
ex.en: She loved swimming as a kid.

ex.r: ni1 gaan1 pou3 ngo5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 lai4
ex.en: I came to this shop all the time as a kid.

words.note: 影相 = take photos. Mandarin uses 拍照.

ex.s: 可唔可以幫我哋影張相？

ex.en: Could you take a photo of us?

ex.r: ngo5 jing2 zo2 hou2 do1 sik6 mat6 soeng2
ex.en: I took lots of food photos.

ex.r: ni1 dou6 m4 zeon2 jing2 soeng2
ex.en: No photos allowed here.

words.note: Pair with 都 in the second part.

ex.r: zau6 syun3 lok6 jyu5 ngo5 dou1 heoi3
ex.en: I'll go even if it rains.

ex.r: zau6 syun3 peng4 ngo5 dou1 m4 maai5
ex.en: Even if it's cheap, I won't buy it.

ex.r: zau6 syun3 hou2 gui6 keoi5 dou1 jiu3 faan1 gung1
ex.en: Even when he's tired, he has to go to work.

words.en: to look like; to resemble; to seem
words.note: 好似 = it seems; like.

ex.r: nei5 go3 zai2 ci5 saai3 nei5
ex.en: Your son looks just like you.

ex.r: ni1 dou6 ci5 jat6 bun2 do1 gwo3 hoeng1 gong2
ex.en: This place looks more like Japan than Hong Kong.

ex.r: tin1 sik1 gam3 hak1 ci5 hai6 jiu3 lok6 jyu5
ex.en: The sky's so dark, it looks like rain.

ex.r: go2 jat6 ngo5 dei6 hai2 bin1 dou6 sik6 faan6 aa3
ex.en: Where did we eat that day?

ex.r: go2 jat6 hou2 daai6 jyu5
ex.en: It rained heavily that day.

ex.r: ngo5 go2 jat6 gin3 dou2 nei5 lou5 sai3
ex.en: I saw your boss the other day.

ex.r: gam1 maan5 heoi3 tai2 hei3 hou2 m4 hou2
ex.en: Want to see a movie tonight?

ex.en: What's this movie about?

ex.en: I watched two movies on the plane.

ex.en: Driver, please stop up ahead.

ex.r: jyu5 ting4 zo2 laa3
ex.en: The rain has stopped.

ex.r: keoi5 jat1 gong2 zau6 ting4 m4 dou2
ex.en: Once she starts talking, she can't stop.

ex.r: teng1 gong2 keoi5 git3 zo2 fan1
ex.en: I heard she got married.

ex.r: teng1 gong2 ni1 gaan1 hou2 hou2 sik6
ex.en: I heard this place is really good.

ex.r: teng1 gong2 ting1 jat6 wui5 daa2 fung1
ex.en: I heard there'll be a typhoon tomorrow.

words.note: 講句嘢 = say something.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 tung4 nei5 gong2 geoi3 je5
ex.en: I want to tell you something.

ex.r: keoi5 jat1 geoi3 dou1 mou5 gong2
ex.en: He didn't say a single word.

ex.r: ni1 geoi3 hai6 mat1 je5 ji3 si1
ex.en: What does this sentence mean?

ex.r: ngo5 lou5 sai3 gam1 jat6 m4 hai2 dou6
ex.en: My boss isn't in today.

ex.r: gaan1 pou3 ge3 lou5 sai3 hou2 hou2 jan4

ex.r: lou5 sai3 maai4 daan1
ex.en: Boss, the check please!

ex.en: I want to borrow money from the bank to buy a flat.

ex.r: ngo5 ze3 zo2 bun2 syu1 bei2 keoi5

words.note: Same meaning as 原本.

ex.en: I save 2,000 dollars a month.

ex.en: My phone has no space left for photos.

ex.r: nei5 go3 hyut3 aat3 zing3 soeng4
ex.en: Your blood pressure is normal.

ex.s: 第一次學係咁㗎，好正常。

ex.en: That's how it is when you first learn, totally normal.

ex.en: There's so much traffic today, it's not normal.

words.note: Often just 易 in speech: 好易.

ex.en: This character is easy to write.

ex.s: 喺香港搵工容易唔容易？

ex.en: It's easy to get sick in winter.

ex.r: m4 tung1 ngo5 jiu3 seng4 jat6 dang2 nei5 me1

ex.s: 我把遮壞咗，借把俾我得唔得？
ex.r: ngo5 baa2 ze1 waai6 zo2 ze3 baa2 bei2 ngo5 dak1 m4 dak1
ex.en: My umbrella broke, can you lend me one?

ex.r: di1 ngau4 naai5 waai6 zo2 m4 hou2 jam2
ex.en: The milk has gone bad, don't drink it.

words.en: to make a mistake; to get wrong
words.note: 有冇搞錯！ = are you kidding me! (annoyed)

ex.r: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 ngo5 gaau2 co3 zo2
ex.en: Sorry, I made a mistake.

ex.r: nei5 gaau2 co3 zo2 zoeng1 daan1 aa3
ex.en: You got the bill wrong.

ex.s: 我搞錯日子，聽日先考試。
ex.r: ngo5 gaau2 co3 jat6 zi2 ting1 jat6 sin1 haau2 si5
ex.en: I got the date wrong, the exam isn't until tomorrow.

ex.s: 我個女讀緊小學三年級。
ex.r: ngo5 go3 neoi2 duk6 gan2 siu2 hok6 saam1 nin4 kap1
ex.en: My daughter is in third grade.

ex.r: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 siu2 hok6 ge3 lou5 si1
ex.en: She was my elementary school teacher.

ex.r: uk1 kei2 fu6 gan6 jau5 gaan1 siu2 hok6
ex.en: There's an elementary school near my home.

words.note: Makes a yes/no question; 係唔係呀? at the end = right?

ex.r: nei5 hai6 m4 hai6 mei5 gwok3 jan4 aa3
ex.en: Are you American?

ex.r: ni1 dou6 hai6 m4 hai6 paai4 deoi2 aa3
ex.en: Is this the line?

ex.r: nei5 hai6 m4 hai6 m4 syu1 fuk6 aa3
ex.en: Are you not feeling well?

words.en: to jump; 跳舞 = to dance

ex.r: keoi5 hoi1 sam1 dou3 tiu3 hei2 san1
ex.en: She jumped up with joy.

ex.r: zek3 gau2 tiu3 zo2 soeng5 cong4
ex.en: The dog jumped onto the bed.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 tiu3 mou5 laa1
ex.en: Let's go dancing!

words.note: Spoken shortcut: 百五 = 150.

ex.r: ni1 deoi3 haai4 saam1 baak3 man1
ex.en: These shoes are 300 dollars.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jau5 gei2 baak3 jan4
ex.en: Our company has a few hundred people.

ex.r: haau2 si5 ngo5 lo2 zo2 jat1 baak3 fan1
ex.en: I got 100 on the exam!

ex.r: ngo5 co5 zung1 gaan1 laa1
ex.en: I'll sit in the middle.

ex.s: 間舖喺銀行同超市中間。
ex.r: gaan1 pou3 hai2 ngan4 hong4 tung4 ciu1 si5 zung1 gaan1
ex.en: The shop is between the bank and the supermarket.

ex.r: tou3 hei3 zung1 gaan1 ngo5 fan3 zoek6 zo2
ex.en: I fell asleep in the middle of the movie.

words.note: Spoken man2. Spoken Cantonese itself = 廣東話.

ex.r: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 gong2 zung1 man2 aa3
ex.en: Can you speak Chinese?

ex.r: ngo5 mui5 maan5 dou1 hok6 zung1 man2
ex.en: I study Chinese every night.

ex.r: jau5 mou5 zung1 man2 caan1 paai2 aa3
ex.en: Is there a Chinese menu?

words.note: Spoken shortcut: 千二 = 1,200.

ex.r: gei1 piu3 jiu3 ng5 cin1 man1
ex.en: The plane ticket costs 5,000 dollars.

ex.r: ni1 tiu4 cyun1 jau5 gei2 cin1 jan4 zyu6
ex.en: A few thousand people live in this village.

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 jat6 haang4 zo2 baat3 cin1 bou6
ex.en: I walked 8,000 steps today.

words.note: Measure word 部.

ex.r: sik6 faan6 m4 hou2 tai2 din6 si6
ex.en: Don't watch TV while eating.

ex.r: zau2 dim3 gaan1 fong2 mou5 din6 si6
ex.en: The hotel room has no TV.

ex.r: cam4 maan5 din6 si6 bo3 zo2 tou3 hou2 hei3
ex.en: There was a good movie on TV last night.

ex.s: 我鍾意食生果，例如蘋果同橙。
ex.r: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 saang1 gwo2 lai6 jyu4 ping4 gwo2 tung4 caang2
ex.en: I like fruit, for example apples and oranges.

ex.s: 我週末會做運動，例如游水。
ex.r: ngo5 zau1 mut6 wui5 zou6 wan6 dung6 lai6 jyu4 jau4 seoi2
ex.en: On weekends I exercise, for example swimming.

ex.s: 去旅行要帶啲嘢，例如護照。
ex.r: heoi3 leoi5 hang4 jiu3 daai3 di1 je5 lai6 jyu4 wu6 ziu3
ex.en: When you travel, bring a few things, like your passport.

words.note: Opposite: 開 (hoi1). In speech, 閂 (saan1) for doors and 熄 (sik1) for lights are common.

ex.r: ceot1 mun4 hau2 gei3 dak1 gwaan1 dang1
ex.en: Remember to turn off the lights when you go out.

ex.r: gaan1 pou3 tau2 gei2 dim2 gwaan1 mun4 aa3
ex.en: What time does the shop close?

ex.s: 好凍呀，可唔可以關咗個冷氣？
ex.r: hou2 dung3 aa3 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gwaan1 zo2 go3 laang5 hei3
ex.en: It's so cold, can we turn off the air conditioning?

words.en: to have a day off; be on holiday

ex.r: ting1 jat6 fong3 gaa3 nei5 jau5 me1 daa2 syun3
ex.en: We're off tomorrow. What are your plans?

ex.r: fong3 gaa3 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4
ex.en: On our holiday we're going to Japan.

ex.r: hok6 haau6 gei2 si4 fong3 gaa3 aa3
ex.en: When does school break start?

words.note: 唔舒服 = unwell, feeling sick.

ex.r: ni1 zoeng1 so1 faa2 hou2 syu1 fuk6
ex.en: This sofa is really comfortable.

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 hai6 gei2 syu1 fuk6
ex.en: I'm not feeling very well today.

ex.r: deoi3 haai4 zoek3 lok6 hou2 syu1 fuk6
ex.en: These shoes are really comfortable to wear.

words.note: Measure word 份 (fan6): 一份報紙.

ex.r: baa4 baa1 mui5 ziu1 dou1 tai2 bou3 zi2
ex.en: Dad reads the newspaper every morning.

ex.r: bin6 lei6 dim3 jau5 bou3 zi2 maai6
ex.en: The convenience store sells newspapers.

ex.r: keoi5 hai2 dei6 tit3 dou6 tai2 gan2 bou3 zi2
ex.en: He's reading a newspaper on the subway.

ex.r: keoi5 ci4 dou3 ge3 jyun4 jan1 hai6 sak1 ce1
ex.en: The reason he was late was traffic.

ex.s: 醫生話咳嘅原因係敏感。
ex.r: ji1 sang1 waa6 kat1 ge3 jyun4 jan1 hai6 man5 gam2
ex.en: The doctor said the cough is caused by an allergy.

ex.s: 我鍾意呢間餐廳，原因好簡單：平。
ex.r: ngo5 zung1 ji3 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jyun4 jan1 hou2 gaan2 daan1 peng4
ex.en: I like this restaurant for a simple reason: it's cheap.

words.en: to mail; to send by post
words.note: For email and texts, people say 發 or 'send'.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 gei3 fung1 seon3 heoi3 mei5 gwok3
ex.en: I want to mail a letter to the US.

ex.s: 網上買嘅嘢幾時寄到呀？
ex.r: mong5 soeng6 maai5 ge3 je5 gei2 si4 gei3 dou3 aa3
ex.en: When will the stuff I bought online arrive?

ex.r: saang1 jat6 kaat1 ngo5 gei3 zo2 bei2 maa4 maa4
ex.en: I mailed the birthday card to Grandma.

words.note: For replying to messages, people usually say 覆 (fuk1).

ex.r: lou5 si1 man6 man6 tai4 keoi5 daap3 m4 dou2
ex.en: The teacher asked a question and he couldn't answer.

ex.r: min6 si3 go2 zan6 keoi5 daap3 dak1 hou2 hou2
ex.en: She answered really well in the interview.

ex.s: 佢問我去唔去，我答佢話去。
ex.r: keoi5 man6 ngo5 heoi3 m4 heoi3 ngo5 daap3 keoi5 waa6 heoi3
ex.en: He asked if I was going, and I told him yes.

words.note: 瞓覺 (fan3 gaau3) = to sleep. Avoid Mandarin 睡.

ex.r: hou2 je6 laa3 faai3 di1 fan3 laa1
ex.en: It's late, go to sleep.

ex.r: ngo5 cam4 maan5 fan3 dak1 m4 hou2
ex.en: I didn't sleep well last night.

ex.r: keoi5 hai2 baa1 si2 dou6 fan3 zoek6 zo2
ex.en: He fell asleep on the bus.

ex.r: zou6 jyun4 gung1 fo3 sin1 ho2 ji5 waan2
ex.en: You can play only after you finish your homework.

ex.r: gam1 jat6 lou5 si1 bei2 hou2 do1 gung1 fo3
ex.en: The teacher gave a lot of homework today.

ex.s: 我同同學一齊喺圖書館做功課。
ex.r: ngo5 tung4 tung4 hok6 jat1 cai4 hai2 tou4 syu1 gun2 zou6 gung1 fo3
ex.en: I do homework with my classmates at the library.

ex.s: 呢個菜好簡單，十分鐘就整好。
ex.r: ni1 go3 coi3 hou2 gaan2 daan1 sap6 fan1 zung1 zau6 zing2 hou2
ex.en: This dish is simple; it's ready in ten minutes.

ex.s: 張表好簡單，填個名就得。
ex.r: zoeng1 biu2 hou2 gaan2 daan1 tin4 go3 meng2 zau6 dak1
ex.en: The form is simple; just fill in your name.

ex.s: 我哋簡單食個飯就算喇。
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 gaan2 daan1 sik6 go3 faan6 zau6 syun3 laa3
ex.en: Let's just have a simple meal.

ex.s: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食好一般。
ex.r: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 jat1 bun1
ex.en: The food at this restaurant is so-so.

ex.r: tou3 hei3 jat1 bun1 laa1 m4 syun3 hou2 tai2
ex.en: The movie was average, not that good.

ex.r: ngo5 jat1 bun1 cat1 dim2 hei2 san1
ex.en: I usually get up at seven.

words.note: Also used to call a shop owner or stall keeper.

ex.r: ngo5 lou5 baan2 gam1 jat6 m4 hai2 dou6
ex.en: My boss isn't in today.

ex.r: gaan1 pou3 ge3 lou5 baan2 hou2 hou2 jan4
ex.en: The shop owner is really nice.

ex.r: lou5 baan2 maai4 daan1 m4 goi1
ex.en: Boss, the bill please!

ex.r: lok6 daai6 jyu5 jing2 hoeng2 zo2 gaau1 tung1
ex.en: The heavy rain affected traffic.

ex.s: 夜晚飲咖啡會影響瞓覺。
ex.r: je6 maan5 jam2 gaa3 fe1 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 fan3 gaau3
ex.en: Drinking coffee at night affects your sleep.

ex.s: 唔好嘈，會影響人哋溫書。
ex.r: m4 hou2 cou4 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 jan4 dei6 wan1 syu1
ex.en: Don't be noisy, you'll disturb people studying.

words.note: Also 有時 (jau5 si4).

ex.r: ngo5 jau5 zan6 si4 wui5 zi6 gei2 zyu2 faan6
ex.en: Sometimes I cook for myself.

ex.s: 有陣時我會搭的士返工。
ex.r: jau5 zan6 si4 ngo5 wui5 daap3 dik1 si2 faan1 gung1
ex.en: Sometimes I take a taxi to work.

ex.s: 呢度冬天有陣時都幾凍。
ex.r: ni1 dou6 dung1 tin1 jau5 zan6 si4 dou1 gei2 dung3
ex.en: It's sometimes pretty cold here in winter.

words.note: Opposite: 入邊 (jap6 bin6), inside.

ex.r: ceot1 bin6 lok6 gan2 jyu5 daai3 baa2 ze1 laa1
ex.en: It's raining outside, take an umbrella.

ex.r: ngo5 hai2 ceot1 bin6 dang2 nei5
ex.en: I'll wait for you outside.

ex.r: gam1 maan5 ceot1 bin6 sik6 laa1
ex.en: Let's eat out tonight.

words.note: 粒鐘 (lap1 zung1) = one hour, very colloquial.

ex.r: sik6 loeng5 lap1 joek6 jat1 jat6 saam1 ci3
ex.en: Take two pills, three times a day.

ex.r: ni1 lap1 tong2 hou2 tim4
ex.en: This candy is really sweet.

ex.r: ngo5 dang2 zo2 nei5 seng4 lap1 zung1
ex.en: I waited for you a whole hour!

words.en: to hand in; to pay; to make (friends)

ex.r: ting1 jat6 jiu3 gaau1 gung1 fo3
ex.en: The homework is due tomorrow.

ex.r: ngo5 mui5 go3 jyut6 jat1 hou6 gaau1 zou1
ex.en: I pay rent on the first of every month.

ex.s: 佢喺英國讀書，交咗好多朋友。
ex.r: keoi5 hai2 jing1 gwok3 duk6 syu1 gaau1 zo2 hou2 do1 pang4 jau5
ex.en: He studied in the UK and made lots of friends.

words.note: Read cung5 for 'heavy'. Meaning 'still', it's zung6 (like 仲).

ex.r: go3 doi2 hou2 cung5 aa3 bong1 ngo5 ling1 haa5
ex.en: This bag is heavy, help me carry it.

ex.r: nei5 go3 hang4 lei5 soeng1 cung5 m4 cung5 aa3
ex.en: Is your suitcase heavy?

ex.r: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 cung5 zo2 loeng5 bong6
ex.en: She's put on two pounds recently.

ex.s: 收音機播緊我最鍾意嘅歌。
ex.r: sau1 jam1 gei1 bo3 gan2 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 go1
ex.en: The radio is playing my favorite song.

ex.r: tou3 kek6 gei2 dim2 bo3 aa3
ex.en: What time does the drama air?

ex.s: 你喺手機播段片俾我睇吓。
ex.r: nei5 hai2 sau2 gei1 bo3 dyun6 pin2 bei2 ngo5 tai2 haa5
ex.en: Play the video on your phone for me.

words.note: Opposite: 落嚟 (come down). 上去 = go up.

ex.r: nei5 soeng5 lai4 ngo5 uk1 kei2 co5 haa5 laa1
ex.en: Come up to my place for a bit.

ex.r: ngoi6 maai6 sung3 zo2 soeng5 lai4 laa3
ex.en: The takeout has been brought up.

ex.s: 我喺二樓，你行樓梯上嚟啦。
ex.r: ngo5 hai2 ji6 lau2 nei5 haang4 lau4 tai1 soeng5 lai4 laa1
ex.en: I'm on the second floor; take the stairs up.

ex.r: di1 man1 hou2 faan4 aa3
ex.en: These mosquitoes are so annoying!

ex.r: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daa2 din6 waa2 lai4 hou2 faan4
ex.en: He calls all the time; it's so annoying.

ex.r: ngo5 wai6 zo2 wan2 gung1 hou2 faan4
ex.en: I'm stressed about finding a job.

words.en: to drive; to hold (in the hand)
words.note: 揸車 = to drive a car. Avoid Mandarin 開車.

ex.r: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 zaa1 ce1 aa3
ex.en: Can you drive?

ex.r: ngo5 zaa1 ce1 sung3 nei5 faan1 uk1 kei2
ex.en: I'll drive you home.

ex.r: keoi5 sau2 zaa1 zyu6 bui1 gaa3 fe1
ex.en: She's holding a cup of coffee.

ex.r: ngo5 do1 sou3 co5 dei6 tit3 faan1 gung1
ex.en: I usually take the subway to work.

ex.r: zau1 mut6 ngo5 do1 sou3 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2
ex.en: On weekends I mostly stay home.

ex.s: 我班同學多數都識游水。
ex.r: ngo5 baan1 tung4 hok6 do1 sou3 dou1 sik1 jau4 seoi2
ex.en: Most of my classmates can swim.

ex.r: siu2 sam1 aa3 dei6 haa2 hou2 waat6
ex.en: Careful, the floor is slippery.

ex.r: gwo3 maa5 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1
ex.en: Be careful crossing the road.

ex.r: siu2 sam1 di1 go3 dip2 hou2 jit6
ex.en: Careful, the plate is hot.

words.note: Often paired with 就: 只要…就….

ex.r: zi2 jiu3 nei5 zung1 ji3 zau6 dak1 laa3
ex.en: As long as you like it, that's fine.

ex.s: 只要唔落雨，我哋就去行山。
ex.r: zi2 jiu3 m4 lok6 jyu5 ngo5 dei6 zau6 heoi3 haang4 saan1
ex.en: As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go hiking.

ex.s: 只要多啲練習，你一定得。
ex.r: zi2 jiu3 do1 di1 lin6 zaap6 nei5 jat1 ding6 dak1
ex.en: As long as you practice more, you'll get it.

words.note: Measure word 首 (sau2): 一首歌.

ex.r: nei5 zung1 ji3 teng1 bin1 go3 ge3 go1 aa3
ex.en: Whose songs do you like to listen to?

ex.r: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 coeng3 go1
ex.en: She loves singing.

ex.r: zaa1 ce1 go2 zan6 ngo5 zung1 ji3 teng1 go1
ex.en: I like listening to music while I drive.

words.note: 錄音 = record audio; 錄影 = record video.

ex.r: ngo5 jung6 sau2 gei1 luk6 zo2 dyun6 pin2
ex.en: I recorded a video on my phone.

ex.s: 個節目我錄咗，第日先睇。
ex.r: go3 zit3 muk6 ngo5 luk6 zo2 dai6 jat6 sin1 tai2
ex.en: I recorded the show to watch another day.

ex.r: soeng5 tong4 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 luk6 jam1 aa3
ex.en: Can I record audio in class?

words.note: Colloquial; the written word is 浪費.

ex.r: m4 hou2 saai1 je5 sik6 aa3
ex.en: Don't waste food.

ex.s: 排咗成個鐘隊，真係嘥時間。
ex.r: paai4 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 deoi2 zan1 hai6 saai1 si4 gaan3
ex.en: We queued a whole hour; what a waste of time.

ex.s: 冇人就熄燈啦，唔好嘥電。
ex.r: mou5 jan4 zau6 sik1 dang1 laa1 m4 hou2 saai1 din6
ex.en: Turn off the lights if no one's there; don't waste electricity.

ex.r: di1 juk6 suk6 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Is the meat cooked yet?

ex.r: di1 hoeng1 ziu1 mei6 suk6 dang2 do1 loeng5 jat6
ex.en: The bananas aren't ripe; wait two more days.

ex.r: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hou2 suk6
ex.en: I know him really well.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng1 seon3 nei5 jat1 ding6 dak1
ex.en: I believe you can do it.

ex.r: nei5 soeng1 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 me1
ex.en: You believe what he says?

ex.s: 醫生話冇事，你要相信醫生。
ex.r: ji1 sang1 waa6 mou5 si6 nei5 jiu3 soeng1 seon3 ji1 sang1
ex.en: The doctor says you're fine; trust the doctor.

words.note: Measure words: 枝 (zi1) for one stem, 束 (cuk1) for a bunch.

ex.r: ngo5 maai5 zo2 cuk1 faa1 bei2 maa4 maa1
ex.en: I bought a bunch of flowers for Mom.

ex.r: gung1 jyun2 di1 faa1 hoi1 saai3 laa3
ex.en: The flowers in the park are all in bloom.

ex.r: keoi5 hai2 lou6 toi4 zung3 zo2 hou2 do1 faa1
ex.en: She grows lots of flowers on her balcony.

ex.r: ngo5 ning4 jyun6 haang4 lou6 m4 soeng2 daap3 ce1
ex.en: I'd rather walk than take a ride.

ex.r: ngo5 ning4 jyun6 hai2 uk1 kei2 sik6
ex.en: I'd rather eat at home.

ex.s: 佢寧願少啲人工都要早啲放工。
ex.r: keoi5 ning4 jyun6 siu2 di1 jan4 gung1 dou1 jiu3 zou2 di1 fong3 gung1
ex.en: She'd rather earn less and finish work earlier.

words.note: Here 重 is zung6, not cung5 (heavy).

ex.r: ting1 jat6 go3 wui2 hou2 zung6 jiu3
ex.en: Tomorrow's meeting is very important.

ex.r: san1 tai2 gin6 hong1 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3
ex.en: Good health is the most important thing.

ex.r: gei3 dak1 daai3 wu6 ziu3 hou2 zung6 jiu3 gaa3
ex.en: Remember your passport, it's really important.

words.note: Colloquial 'next to'. In the news it can also mean 'quarantine'.

ex.r: ngo5 zyu6 hai2 keoi5 gaak3 lei4
ex.en: I live next door to him.

ex.r: ngan4 hong4 zau6 hai2 ciu1 si5 gaak3 lei4
ex.en: The bank is right next to the supermarket.

ex.r: ngo5 co5 hai2 san1 tung4 hok6 gaak3 lei4
ex.en: I sit next to the new classmate.

ex.r: nei5 gaan1 fong2 hou2 lyun6 aa3
ex.en: Your room is so messy!

ex.r: di1 man4 gin2 fong3 dak1 hou2 lyun6
ex.en: The documents are all over the place.

ex.r: nei5 m4 hou2 lyun6 gong2 je5 aa3
ex.en: Don't talk nonsense!

words.note: Opposite: 難 (naan4). Also 容易.

ex.r: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 hou2 ji6
ex.en: This exam was easy.

ex.r: ni1 go3 si4 gaan3 hou2 ji6 zit6 dik1 si2
ex.en: It's easy to get a taxi at this time.

ex.r: tin1 dung3 hou2 ji6 gam2 mou6
ex.en: It's easy to catch a cold when it's cold.

ex.r: dong1 si4 ngo5 zung6 hai6 hok6 saang1
ex.en: Back then I was still a student.

ex.s: 當時好多人，我睇唔到你。
ex.r: dong1 si4 hou2 do1 jan4 ngo5 tai2 m4 dou2 nei5
ex.en: There were so many people then that I couldn't see you.

ex.r: ngo5 dong1 si4 m4 zi1 keoi5 beng6 zo2
ex.en: I didn't know at the time that she was sick.

words.en: to pick up (someone); to answer (a call)

ex.r: ngo5 heoi3 gei1 coeng4 zip3 nei5
ex.en: I'll pick you up at the airport.

ex.r: fong3 hok6 ngo5 heoi3 zip3 go3 zai2
ex.en: I'll pick up my son after school.

ex.r: keoi5 hoi1 gan2 wui2 zip3 m4 dou2 din6 waa2
ex.en: She's in a meeting and can't take calls.

words.note: Usually followed by 都. Same as 每日.

ex.r: ngo5 jat6 jat6 dou1 jam2 gaa3 fe1
ex.en: I drink coffee every day.

ex.r: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 heoi3 zou6 wan6 dung6
ex.en: He works out every day.

ex.r: jat6 jat6 dou1 gam3 jit6 hou2 san1 fu2
ex.en: It's this hot every day; it's rough.

ex.r: ngo5 zi2 hai6 soeng2 jau1 sik1 haa5
ex.en: I just want to rest a bit.

ex.r: zi2 hai6 tai2 haa5 m4 goi1
ex.en: Just looking, thanks.

ex.r: keoi5 m4 hai6 nau1 nei5 zi2 hai6 hou2 gui6
ex.en: She's not mad at you, she's just tired.

words.note: 冇關係 = it doesn't matter, no problem.

ex.r: mou5 gwaan1 hai6 m4 sai2 daam1 sam1
ex.en: It's okay, don't worry.

ex.r: keoi5 tung4 lou5 baan2 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 hou2
ex.en: He gets along really well with the boss.

ex.r: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 me1 gwaan1 hai6 aa3
ex.en: How are those two related?

words.note: 係噉先 = that's all for now. 係噉 + verb = keep doing.

ex.r: jyun4 loi4 hai6 gam2
ex.en: Oh, so that's how it is!

ex.r: hai6 gam2 sin1 laa1 ting1 jat6 gin3
ex.en: That's it for now, see you tomorrow.

ex.r: keoi5 hai6 gam2 haam3 m4 hang2 ting4
ex.en: He keeps crying and won't stop.

ex.r: ngo5 zeon2 bei6 gan2 maan5 faan6
ex.en: I'm making dinner.

ex.s: 你準備好未呀？我哋要走喇。
ex.r: nei5 zeon2 bei6 hou2 mei6 aa3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zau2 laa3
ex.en: Are you ready? We have to go.

ex.r: ting1 jat6 min6 si3 ngo5 jiu3 zeon2 bei6 haa5
ex.en: I have an interview tomorrow; I need to prepare.

words.note: Measure word 隻. As 'a plate of' (一碟飯), it's read dip6.

ex.r: m4 goi1 bei2 do1 zek3 dip2 ngo5
ex.en: Could I have another plate, please?

ex.r: bong1 sau2 lo2 di1 dip2 ceot1 lai4
ex.en: Help bring the plates out.

ex.r: ni1 tou3 dip2 hou2 leng3 gei2 cin2 aa3
ex.en: This set of plates is nice. How much is it?

words.en: to discover; to find out; to realize

ex.s: 我返到屋企先發現冇帶鎖匙。
ex.r: ngo5 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 sin1 faat3 jin6 mou5 daai3 so2 si4
ex.en: I only realized I'd forgotten my keys when I got home.

ex.s: 我發現呢間餐廳好好食。
ex.r: ngo5 faat3 jin6 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 hou2 sik6
ex.en: I found out this restaurant is really good.

ex.r: ji1 sang1 faat3 jin6 keoi5 hyut3 aat3 gou1
ex.en: The doctor found she has high blood pressure.

ex.r: haau2 si5 git3 gwo2 gei2 si4 ceot1 aa3
ex.en: When do the exam results come out?

ex.r: jim6 hyut3 git3 gwo2 mou5 man6 tai4
ex.en: The blood test results are fine.

ex.s: 我哋等咗好耐，結果佢冇嚟。
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 dang2 zo2 hou2 noi6 git3 gwo2 keoi5 mou5 lai4
ex.en: We waited ages, and in the end he didn't come.

ex.r: syu2 gaa3 nei5 heoi3 bin1 dou6 waan2 aa3
ex.en: Where are you going for summer vacation?

ex.s: 暑假我喺咖啡店做兼職。
ex.r: syu2 gaa3 ngo5 hai2 gaa3 fe1 dim3 zou6 gim1 zik1
ex.en: Over the summer I work part-time at a café.

ex.s: 啲細路暑假日日喺屋企打機。
ex.r: di1 sai3 lou6 syu2 gaa3 jat6 jat6 hai2 uk1 kei2 daa2 gei1
ex.en: The kids play video games at home every day over the summer.

words.note: Verb + 齊 = do all of it. 人齊 = everyone's here.

ex.r: jan4 cai4 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Is everyone here yet?

ex.r: di1 je5 maai5 cai4 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Have you bought everything?

ex.r: man4 gin2 daai3 cai4 saai3 laa3
ex.en: I've brought all the documents.

words.note: Family name comes first: 陳先生 = Mr. Chan.

ex.r: can4 sin1 saang1 nei5 hou2
ex.en: Hello, Mr. Chan.

ex.r: sin1 saang1 nei5 jiu3 di1 me1 aa3
ex.en: Sir, what would you like?

ex.r: ngo5 sin1 saang1 gam1 maan5 gaa1 baan1
ex.en: My husband is working late tonight.

ex.r: nei5 kyut3 ding6 zo2 sik6 me1 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Have you decided what to eat?

ex.s: 我決定聽年去台灣讀書。
ex.r: ngo5 kyut3 ding6 ting1 nin2 heoi3 toi4 waan1 duk6 syu1
ex.en: I've decided to study in Taiwan next year.

ex.r: maai5 bin1 gaa3 ce1 nei5 kyut3 ding6 laa1
ex.en: You decide which car to buy.

ex.r: keoi5 uk1 kei2 hou2 jau5 cin2
ex.en: His family is very rich.

ex.r: dang2 ngo5 jau5 cin2 sin1 maai5 san1 sau2 gei1
ex.en: I'll buy a new phone when I have money.

ex.s: 出糧之後就有錢食好嘢。
ex.r: ceot1 loeng4 zi1 hau6 zau6 jau5 cin2 sik6 hou2 je5
ex.en: After payday we have money for good food.

words.note: 搬屋 = to move house.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 bun1 uk1
ex.en: We're moving next month.

ex.r: keoi5 gung1 si1 bun1 zo2 heoi3 gun1 tong4
ex.en: His company moved to Kwun Tong.

ex.r: ni1 soeng1 je5 hou2 cung5 ngo5 bun1 m4 juk1
ex.en: This box is too heavy; I can't move it.

words.note: Use 個: 兩個鐘頭. Also 個鐘 (go3 zung1).

ex.r: ngo5 mui5 jat6 faan1 baat3 go3 zung1 tau4 gung1
ex.en: I work eight hours a day.

ex.s: 由香港飛東京要四個鐘頭。
ex.r: jau4 hoeng1 gong2 fei1 dung1 ging1 jiu3 sei3 go3 zung1 tau4
ex.en: Flying from Hong Kong to Tokyo takes four hours.

ex.s: 我哋傾咗兩個鐘頭電話。
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 king1 zo2 loeng5 go3 zung1 tau4 din6 waa2
ex.en: We talked on the phone for two hours.

words.note: 洗衫 = do laundry. To shower is 沖涼 (cung1 loeng4).

ex.r: sik6 faan6 cin4 jiu3 sai2 sau2
ex.en: Wash your hands before eating.

ex.r: gam1 maan5 dou3 nei5 sai2 wun2
ex.en: It's your turn to do the dishes tonight.

ex.r: ngo5 heoi3 faat3 jing4 uk1 sai2 tau4
ex.en: I'm going to the hair salon to get my hair washed.

words.note: 排隊 (paai4 deoi2) = to queue.

ex.r: ni1 gaan1 pou3 jiu3 paai4 hou2 noi6 deoi2
ex.en: You have to queue a long time at this shop.

ex.r: daai6 gaa1 paai4 hou2 deoi2 soeng5 ce1
ex.en: Everyone, line up to get on.

ex.s: 我哋排咗成個鐘先入到場。
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 paai4 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 sin1 jap6 dou2 coeng4
ex.en: We queued a whole hour before we got into the venue.

words.note: 夜晚 = night. 瞓得夜 = go to bed late.

ex.r: hou2 je6 laa3 ngo5 dei6 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa1
ex.en: It's late; let's go home.

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 zou6 dou3 hou2 je6
ex.en: I have to work late today.

ex.s: 咁夜仲食嘢，對身體唔好。
ex.r: gam3 je6 zung6 sik6 je5 deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hou2
ex.en: Eating this late isn't good for you.

words.note: 病咗 = (has) got sick.

ex.r: keoi5 beng6 zo2 gam1 jat6 m4 faan1 gung1
ex.en: He's sick and not coming to work today.

ex.r: ngo5 go3 zai2 beng6 zo2 jiu3 tai2 ji1 sang1
ex.en: My son is sick and needs to see a doctor.

ex.r: keoi5 go3 beng6 hou2 faan1 hou2 do1 laa3
ex.en: His illness has gotten a lot better.

ex.r: tin1 hei3 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 jit6
ex.en: The weather is getting hotter and hotter.

ex.s: 你廣東話講得越嚟越好喎！
ex.r: nei5 gwong2 dung1 waa2 gong2 dak1 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 hou2 wo3
ex.en: Your Cantonese is getting better and better!

ex.r: di1 je5 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 gwai3
ex.en: Things are getting more and more expensive.

words.note: Often 還返 (waan4 faan1), to give back.

ex.r: ngo5 ting1 jat6 waan4 cin2 bei2 nei5
ex.en: I'll pay you back tomorrow.

ex.r: di1 syu1 jiu3 waan4 faan1 bei2 tou4 syu1 gun2
ex.en: The books need to go back to the library.

ex.s: 架車你用完記得還返俾我。
ex.r: gaa3 ce1 nei5 jung6 jyun4 gei3 dak1 waan4 faan1 bei2 ngo5
ex.en: Remember to give the car back when you're done.

words.note: Only for past events. For future 'later', use 遲啲 or 第時.

ex.r: keoi5 hau6 loi4 bun1 zo2 heoi3 gaa1 naa4 daai6
ex.en: Later he moved to Canada.

ex.s: 我哋本來想去，後來落雨就冇去。
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 bun2 loi4 soeng2 heoi3 hau6 loi4 lok6 jyu5 zau6 mou5 heoi3
ex.en: We meant to go, but then it rained, so we didn't.

ex.r: hau6 loi4 dim2 aa3 nei5 wan2 dou2 gung1 mei6
ex.en: What happened after that? Did you find a job?

words.note: Friendly way to address a young woman, e.g. a shop assistant.

ex.r: nei5 go3 neoi2 hou2 leng3 neoi2 aa3
ex.en: Your daughter is so pretty!

ex.r: keoi5 neoi5 pang4 jau5 hou2 leng3 neoi2
ex.en: His girlfriend is very pretty.

ex.s: 靚女，呢件衫有冇細碼呀？
ex.r: leng3 neoi2 ni1 gin6 saam1 jau5 mou5 sai3 maa5 aa3
ex.en: Miss, do you have this top in a small?

ex.r: keoi5 jau5 sap6 nin4 gaau3 syu1 ging1 jim6
ex.en: She has ten years of teaching experience.

ex.s: 去日本旅行係個好特別嘅經驗。
ex.r: heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4 hai6 go3 hou2 dak6 bit6 ge3 ging1 jim6
ex.en: Traveling in Japan was a really special experience.

ex.r: cau3 sai3 lou6 ngo5 mou5 mat1 ging1 jim6
ex.en: I don't have much experience looking after kids.

words.note: Opposite: 女仔 (girl).

ex.r: keoi5 saang1 zo2 go3 naam4 zai2
ex.en: She had a baby boy.

ex.r: baan1 soeng6 jau5 sap6 go3 naam4 zai2
ex.en: There are ten boys in the class.

ex.s: 嗰個男仔係你朋友嚟㗎？
ex.r: go2 go3 naam4 zai2 hai6 nei5 pang4 jau5 lai4 gaa3
ex.en: Is that guy your friend?

ex.r: ziu1 zou2 ge3 dei6 tit3 hou2 bik1
ex.en: The subway is packed in the morning.

ex.s: 間屋好細，住四個人好迫。
ex.r: gaan1 uk1 hou2 sai3 zyu6 sei3 go3 jan4 hou2 bik1
ex.en: The flat is small; it's cramped for four people.

ex.r: keoi5 aa3 maa1 bik1 keoi5 hok6 kam4
ex.en: Her mom makes her learn piano.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng5 mong5 caa4 haa5 gei2 dim2 hoi1 mun4
ex.en: I'll check online what time it opens.

ex.r: m4 sik1 go3 zi6 zau6 caa4 zi6 din2 laa1
ex.en: If you don't know the word, look it up in a dictionary.

ex.s: 機場職員要查我哋嘅行李。
ex.r: gei1 coeng4 zik1 jyun4 jiu3 caa4 ngo5 dei6 ge3 hang4 lei5
ex.en: Airport staff need to check our luggage.

ex.r: m4 goi1 bei2 zi1 seoi2 ngo5
ex.en: A bottle of water, please.

ex.r: nei5 jau5 mou5 zi1 bat1 ze3 ngo5 aa3
ex.en: Do you have a pen I can borrow?

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 jam2 do1 zi1 be1 zau2 laa1
ex.en: Let's have another bottle of beer.

ex.r: dai6 si4 ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 au1 zau1 leoi5 hang4
ex.en: Someday I want to travel to Europe.

ex.r: nei5 dai6 si4 soeng2 zou6 me1 gung1 aa3
ex.en: What job do you want to do in the future?

ex.r: ji4 gaa1 cyu5 cin2 dai6 si4 maai5 lau2
ex.en: Save money now to buy a flat someday.

ex.s: 你睇咗今日嘅新聞未呀？
ex.r: nei5 tai2 zo2 gam1 jat6 ge3 san1 man2 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Have you seen today's news?

ex.r: ngo5 hai2 sau2 gei1 tai2 san1 man2
ex.en: I read the news on my phone.

ex.r: san1 man2 waa6 ting1 jat6 wui5 daa2 fung1
ex.en: The news says a typhoon is coming tomorrow.

words.note: For choice questions. In statements, 'or' is 或者.

ex.r: nei5 jam2 caa4 ding6 hai6 gaa3 fe1 aa3
ex.en: Would you like tea or coffee?

ex.s: 我哋搭地鐵定係搭的士呀？
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 daap3 dei6 tit3 ding6 hai6 daap3 dik1 si2 aa3
ex.en: Shall we take the subway or a taxi?

ex.r: nei5 jiu3 hung4 sik1 ding6 hai6 laam4 sik1
ex.en: Do you want red or blue?

ex.r: ngo5 zaam6 si4 zyu6 hai2 pang4 jau5 uk1 kei2
ex.en: I'm staying at a friend's place for now.

ex.r: zaam6 si4 mou5 man6 tai4 do1 ze6
ex.en: No problems for now, thanks.

ex.s: 醫生話暫時唔好做運動。
ex.r: ji1 sang1 waa6 zaam6 si4 m4 hou2 zou6 wan6 dung6
ex.en: The doctor said not to exercise for now.

words.en: to shout; to call (out); to order (food)
words.note: 嗌交 (aai3 gaau1) = to argue.

ex.s: 唔好嗌咁大聲，細路瞓緊覺。
ex.r: m4 hou2 aai3 gam3 daai6 seng1 sai3 lou6 fan3 gan2 gaau3
ex.en: Don't shout so loudly; the kid is sleeping.

ex.r: keoi5 hai2 gaai1 dou6 aai3 ngo5 go3 meng2
ex.en: She called out my name on the street.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 aai3 ngoi6 maai6 laa1
ex.en: Let's order takeout.

words.note: Opposite: 壞處 (waai6 cyu3).

ex.s: 住喺呢度嘅好處係近地鐵站。
ex.r: zyu6 hai2 ni1 dou6 ge3 hou2 cyu3 hai6 kan5 dei6 tit3 zaam6
ex.en: The good thing about living here is it's near the subway.

ex.r: zou2 fan3 zou2 hei2 jau5 hou2 do1 hou2 cyu3
ex.en: Going to bed and getting up early has lots of benefits.

ex.s: 呢份工最大嘅好處係唔使加班。
ex.r: ni1 fan6 gung1 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 hou2 cyu3 hai6 m4 sai2 gaa1 baan1
ex.en: The best thing about this job is no overtime.

words.en: to endure; to put up with
words.note: 捱夜 = stay up late. 捱苦 = go through hardship.

ex.s: 佢後生嗰陣捱咗好多苦。
ex.r: keoi5 hau6 saang1 go2 zan6 ngaai4 zo2 hou2 do1 fu2
ex.en: He went through a lot of hardship when he was young.

ex.r: ngo5 cam4 maan5 ngaai4 je6 zou6 je5
ex.en: I stayed up late working last night.

ex.s: 唔好成日捱夜，對身體唔好。
ex.r: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 ngaai4 je6 deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hou2
ex.en: Don't stay up late all the time; it's bad for you.

ex.r: tai2 pin2 seng4 jat6 jau5 gwong2 gou3 hou2 faan4
ex.en: Videos always have ads; it's so annoying.

ex.s: 我喺報紙見到個招聘廣告。
ex.r: ngo5 hai2 bou3 zi2 gin3 dou2 go3 ziu1 ping3 gwong2 gou3
ex.en: I saw a job ad in the newspaper.

ex.r: dei6 tit3 zaam6 jau5 hou2 do1 gwong2 gou3
ex.en: There are lots of ads in the subway station.

words.en: to pass by; to go through

ex.r: ngo5 faan1 gung1 wui5 ging1 gwo3 nei5 uk1 kei2
ex.en: I pass your place on my way to work.

ex.s: 經過超市幫我買支牛奶。
ex.r: ging1 gwo3 ciu1 si5 bong1 ngo5 maai5 zi1 ngau4 naai5
ex.en: When you pass the supermarket, grab me a bottle of milk.

ex.s: 呢架巴士經唔經過中環㗎？
ex.r: ni1 gaa3 baa1 si2 ging1 m4 ging1 gwo3 zung1 waan4 gaa3
ex.en: Does this bus go through Central?

ex.r: soeng5 tong4 m4 hou2 gong2 je5
ex.en: Don't talk in class.

ex.r: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 daai6 seng1
ex.en: He talks really loudly.

ex.s: 我同你講嘢，你有冇聽呀？
ex.r: ngo5 tung4 nei5 gong2 je5 nei5 jau5 mou5 teng1 aa3
ex.en: I'm talking to you. Are you listening?

words.note: Verb + 慣 = used to doing it; verb + 唔慣 = not used to it.

ex.r: ngo5 mei6 gwaan3 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 tin1 hei3
ex.en: I'm not used to Hong Kong's weather yet.

ex.r: ngo5 sik6 m4 gwaan3 gam3 laat6 ge3 je5
ex.en: I'm not used to eating food this spicy.

ex.s: 做咗一個月，而家慣晒喇。
ex.r: zou6 zo2 jat1 go3 jyut6 ji4 gaa1 gwaan3 saai3 laa3
ex.en: After a month on the job, I'm totally used to it.

words.note: Also 朝早 (ziu1 zou2). 'Good morning' is 早晨.

ex.r: ngo5 ziu1 tau4 zou2 jiu3 jam2 gaa3 fe1
ex.en: I need coffee in the morning.

ex.s: 聽日朝頭早九點喺公司見。
ex.r: ting1 jat6 ziu1 tau4 zou2 gau2 dim2 hai2 gung1 si1 gin3
ex.en: See you at the office at nine tomorrow morning.

ex.r: ziu1 tau4 zou2 heoi3 haang4 saan1 mou5 gam3 jit6
ex.en: Hiking in the morning isn't as hot.

words.en: to bump (into); to crash; to run into

ex.r: keoi5 zaa1 ce1 zong6 zo2 gaa3 dik1 si2
ex.en: He crashed into a taxi while driving.

ex.r: siu2 sam1 aa3 m4 hou2 zong6 dou2 go3 tau4
ex.en: Careful, don't bump your head.

ex.r: ngo5 hai2 ciu1 si5 zong6 dou2 gau6 tung4 hok6
ex.en: I ran into an old classmate at the supermarket.

words.note: Scissors = 較剪 (gaau3 zin2).

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 zin2 tau4 faat3
ex.en: I want to get a haircut.

ex.r: ngo5 bong1 go3 zai2 zin2 zi2 gaap3
ex.en: I'm trimming my son's nails.

ex.r: jung6 gaau3 zin2 zin2 hoi1 go3 baau1 zong1
ex.en: Cut the packaging open with scissors.

ex.r: bei2 hei2 hoeng1 gong2 nau2 joek3 dung3 hou2 do1
ex.en: Compared with Hong Kong, New York is much colder.

ex.s: 比起出邊食，我寧願喺屋企煮。
ex.r: bei2 hei2 ceot1 bin6 sik6 ngo5 ning4 jyun6 hai2 uk1 kei2 zyu2
ex.en: Rather than eating out, I'd prefer to cook at home.

ex.s: 比起舊年，今年生意好咗。
ex.r: bei2 hei2 gau6 nin2 gam1 nin2 saang1 ji3 hou2 zo2
ex.en: Compared with last year, business is better this year.

words.note: HK secondary school covers about US grades 7–12. 小學 = primary school.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 hai6 zung1 hok6 tung4 hok6
ex.en: We were classmates in high school.

ex.r: go3 neoi2 gam1 nin2 sing1 zung1 hok6
ex.en: My daughter starts secondary school this year.

ex.r: keoi5 hai2 zung1 hok6 gaau3 jing1 man2
ex.en: She teaches English at a secondary school.

words.note: 慢慢嚟 = take your time.

ex.r: maan6 maan2 sik6 m4 sai2 gap1
ex.en: Eat slowly, there's no rush.

ex.r: nei5 maan6 maan2 gong2 ngo5 teng1 gan2
ex.en: Take your time telling me; I'm listening.

ex.r: lok6 jyu5 lou6 waat6 maan6 maan2 haang4
ex.en: It's rainy and slippery, so walk slowly.

words.en: can't be bothered; to save trouble

ex.r: ngo5 fai3 si6 zyu2 ceot1 heoi3 sik6 laa1
ex.en: I can't be bothered to cook; let's eat out.

ex.r: ngo5 fai3 si6 tung4 keoi5 aai3 gaau1
ex.en: I can't be bothered to argue with him.

ex.r: daai3 maai4 baa2 ze1 laa1 fai3 si6 lam4 sap1
ex.en: Take an umbrella so you don't get soaked.

words.en: for no reason; out of nowhere
words.note: Colloquial; same as 無緣無故.

ex.r: bou6 din6 nou5 mou4 dyun1 dyun1 sik1 zo2
ex.en: The computer shut off for no reason.

ex.r: keoi5 mou4 dyun1 dyun1 haam3 hei2 soeng5 lai4
ex.en: She started crying for no reason.

ex.r: ngo5 mou4 dyun1 dyun1 tou5 tung3
ex.en: I got a stomachache out of nowhere.

words.note: 減肥 = lose weight; 減價 = on sale.

ex.r: ngo5 jiu3 gaam2 fei4
ex.en: I need to lose weight.

ex.r: ni1 gin6 saam1 gaam2 gan2 gaa3
ex.en: This shirt is on sale.

ex.r: gung1 si1 gam1 nin2 gaam2 zo2 jan4 gung1
ex.en: The company cut salaries this year.

ex.r: dat6 jin4 gaan1 lok6 daai6 jyu5
ex.en: Suddenly it started pouring.

ex.s: 突然間停電，乜都睇唔到。
ex.r: dat6 jin4 gaan1 ting4 din6 mat1 dou1 tai2 m4 dou2
ex.en: Suddenly the power went out and I couldn't see a thing.

ex.r: keoi5 dat6 jin4 gaan1 waa6 m4 lai4
ex.en: He suddenly said he wasn't coming.

words.note: 做生意 = to do business, run a business.

ex.r: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 saang1 ji3 hou2 hou2
ex.en: This restaurant does great business.

ex.r: keoi5 zi6 gei2 zou6 saang1 ji3
ex.en: He runs his own business.

ex.s: 落雨天，啲舖頭冇乜生意。
ex.r: lok6 jyu5 tin1 di1 pou3 tau2 mou5 mat1 saang1 ji3
ex.en: On rainy days, the shops don't get much business.

words.note: Measure word 隻 for one eye, 對 for a pair.

ex.r: ngo5 zek3 ngaan5 hou2 han4
ex.en: My eye is really itchy.

ex.r: saan1 maai4 ngaan5 fan3 gaau3 laa1
ex.en: Close your eyes and go to sleep.

ex.r: keoi5 deoi3 ngaan5 hou2 leng3
ex.en: She has beautiful eyes.

words.note: For 'like', Cantonese usually says 鍾意; 愛 is stronger.

ex.r: ngo5 hou2 oi3 ngo5 uk1 kei2 jan4
ex.en: I really love my family.

ex.en: As you get older you should exercise more.

words.note: Mandarin 去年. 今年 this year, 下年 next year.

ex.r: ngo5 gau6 nin2 heoi3 zo2 jat6 bun2
ex.en: I went to Japan last year.

ex.r: keoi5 gau6 nin2 bun1 zo2 uk1
ex.en: She moved house last year.

ex.r: gau6 nin2 dung1 tin1 mou5 gam3 dung3
ex.en: Last winter wasn't this cold.

words.note: 預埋我 = count me in. 預咗 = saw it coming.

ex.r: nei5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 faan6 jyu6 maai4 ngo5 laa1
ex.en: If you're going out to eat, count me in!

ex.r: ngo5 jyu6 zo2 keoi5 wui5 ci4 dou3
ex.en: I expected he'd be late.

ex.s: 星期六唔好預我喇，我要返工。
ex.r: sing1 kei4 luk6 m4 hou2 jyu6 ngo5 laa3 ngo5 jiu3 faan1 gung1
ex.en: Don't count me in for Saturday, I have to work.

words.note: 呢款 = this style/model.

ex.r: ni1 fun2 sau2 gei1 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3
ex.en: How much is this phone model?

ex.r: ni1 gin6 saam1 jau5 mou5 dai6 ji6 fun2 aa3
ex.en: Does this top come in other styles?

ex.r: ngo5 zung1 ji3 go2 fun2 daan6 gou1
ex.en: I like that kind of cake.

words.note: Measure word 間. 搬屋 = to move house.

ex.r: keoi5 dei6 maai5 zo2 gaan1 uk1
ex.en: They bought a flat.

ex.r: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 bun1 uk1
ex.en: I'm moving house next month.

ex.r: nei5 gaan1 uk1 hou2 leng3 aa3
ex.en: Your place is really nice!

words.note: 錢 is cin4 here, not the usual cin2.

ex.r: ni1 go3 gaa3 cin4 hou2 dai2
ex.en: This price is a great deal.

ex.r: nei5 man6 zo2 gaa3 cin4 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Have you asked the price yet?

ex.r: di1 caan1 teng1 gaa3 cin4 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 gwai3
ex.en: Restaurant prices keep going up.

words.note: 嚇親 = got a fright.

ex.r: nei5 haak3 can1 ngo5 aa3
ex.en: You scared me!

ex.r: m4 hou2 haak3 go3 sai3 lou6
ex.en: Don't frighten the kid.

ex.r: go3 gaa3 cin4 haak3 sei2 jan4
ex.en: The price is shocking.

words.note: Measure word 張. 影相 = to take photos.

ex.r: m4 goi1 bong1 ngo5 dei6 jing2 zoeng1 soeng2 aa1
ex.en: Could you please take a photo of us?

ex.r: ngo5 cyun4 zo2 di1 soeng2 bei2 nei5
ex.en: I sent you the photos.

ex.r: ni1 zoeng1 soeng2 jing2 dak1 hou2 leng3
ex.en: This photo came out really nice.

words.en: to book; to reserve; to order
words.note: 訂枱 = book a table.

ex.r: ngo5 deng6 zo2 gam1 maan5 cat1 dim2 ge3 toi2
ex.en: I booked a table for seven tonight.

ex.r: nei5 deng6 zo2 gei1 piu3 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Have you booked your plane tickets yet?

ex.r: ngo5 hai2 mong5 soeng6 deng6 zo2 bun2 syu1
ex.en: I ordered a book online.

words.en: for (the sake of); in order to

ex.r: ngo5 wai6 zo2 keoi5 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2
ex.en: I'm learning Cantonese for her.

ex.r: wai6 zo2 haan1 cin2 ngo5 jat6 jat6 daai3 faan6
ex.en: To save money, I bring my lunch every day.

ex.r: keoi5 wai6 zo2 fan6 gung1 bun1 heoi3 jing1 gwok3
ex.en: She moved to the UK for the job.

ex.r: zeoi3 gan6 faan1 gung1 aat3 lik6 hou2 daai6
ex.en: Work has been really stressful lately.

ex.r: m4 hou2 bei2 zi6 gei2 gam3 daai6 aat3 lik6
ex.en: Don't put so much pressure on yourself.

ex.s: 考試前好多學生都有壓力。
ex.r: haau2 si5 cin4 hou2 do1 hok6 saang1 dou1 jau5 aat3 lik6
ex.en: Lots of students feel stressed before exams.

words.note: Opposite: 推 teoi1 (to push).

ex.r: ni1 dou6 dou6 mun4 jiu3 laai1 m4 hai6 teoi1
ex.en: This door needs to be pulled, not pushed.

ex.r: keoi5 laai1 zyu6 ngo5 zek3 sau2 m4 fong3
ex.en: She held onto my hand and wouldn't let go.

ex.r: ngo5 laai1 zyu6 go3 gip1 heoi3 daap3 ce1
ex.en: I dragged my suitcase along to catch my ride.

words.note: 點算好？ = What should I do?

ex.r: m4 gin3 zo2 so2 si4 dim2 syun3 aa3
ex.en: I've lost my keys, what do I do?

ex.r: lok6 gam3 daai6 jyu5 gam1 jat6 dim2 syun3 hou2
ex.en: It's pouring, what should we do today?

ex.r: keoi5 m4 teng1 din6 waa2 dim2 syun3
ex.en: She's not picking up the phone, what now?

ex.r: maak3 daai6 go3 hau2
ex.en: Open your mouth wide.

ex.s: 個細路成日將啲玩具放落口。
ex.r: go3 sai3 lou6 seng4 jat6 zoeng1 di1 wun6 geoi6 fong3 lok6 hau2
ex.en: The kid keeps putting toys in his mouth.

ex.r: ngo5 hai2 mun4 hau2 dang2 nei5
ex.en: I'll wait for you at the door.

words.en: from now on; in the future; after

ex.r: ji5 hau6 m4 hou2 zoi3 ci4 dou3 laa3
ex.en: Don't be late again from now on.

ex.r: ngo5 ji5 hau6 soeng2 zou6 ji1 sang1
ex.en: I want to be a doctor in the future.

ex.r: sik6 jyun4 faan6 ji5 hau6 heoi3 haang4 gaai1 laa1
ex.en: After dinner, let's go shopping.

words.note: Can split: 結咗婚 = got married.

ex.r: keoi5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 git3 fan1
ex.en: They're getting married next month.

ex.r: nei5 dei6 git3 fan1 gei2 noi6 laa3
ex.en: How long have you been married?

ex.s: 我表姐結婚請咗兩百個人。
ex.r: ngo5 biu2 ze2 git3 fan1 ceng2 zo2 loeng5 baak3 go3 jan4
ex.en: My cousin invited 200 people to her wedding.

words.note: Months are number + 月.

ex.r: ngo5 luk6 jyut6 fong3 syu2 gaa3
ex.en: My summer vacation starts in June.

ex.s: 六月好熱，記得飲多啲水。
ex.r: luk6 jyut6 hou2 jit6 gei3 dak1 jam2 do1 di1 seoi2
ex.en: June is really hot, remember to drink plenty of water.

ex.r: keoi5 saang1 jat6 hai2 luk6 jyut6
ex.en: Her birthday is in June.

ex.s: 我好鍾意食生果，尤其是芒果。
ex.r: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 saang1 gwo2 jau4 kei4 si6 mong1 gwo2
ex.en: I love fruit, especially mango.

ex.s: 香港好熱，尤其是七八月。
ex.r: hoeng1 gong2 hou2 jit6 jau4 kei4 si6 cat1 baat3 jyut6
ex.en: Hong Kong is hot, especially in July and August.

ex.s: 返工好忙，尤其是星期一。
ex.r: faan1 gung1 hou2 mong4 jau4 kei4 si6 sing1 kei4 jat1
ex.en: Work is busy, especially on Mondays.

words.note: Also 哥哥 go4 go1. Younger brother is 細佬.

ex.r: ngo5 aa3 go1 daai6 ngo5 saam1 seoi3
ex.en: My older brother is three years older than me.

ex.r: keoi5 aa3 go1 hai2 gaa1 naa4 daai6 duk6 syu1
ex.en: His older brother is studying in Canada.

ex.r: aa3 go1 seng4 jat6 bong1 ngo5 zou6 gung1 fo3
ex.en: My big brother often helps me with my homework.

ex.r: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 jing6 zan1
ex.en: She's very conscientious at work.

ex.r: nei5 gong2 siu3 ding6 jing6 zan1 gaa3
ex.en: Are you joking or serious?

ex.r: jing6 zan1 di1 teng1 lou5 si1 gong2 je5 laa1
ex.en: Listen to the teacher more carefully.

words.en: to pretend; to dress up as

ex.r: keoi5 baan6 m4 sik1 ngo5
ex.en: He pretended not to know me.

ex.r: m4 hou2 baan6 fan3 laa1 hei2 san1
ex.en: Stop pretending to sleep, get up!

ex.r: maan6 sing3 zit3 keoi5 baan6 zo2 pin1 fuk1 hap6
ex.en: On Halloween he dressed up as Batman.

ex.r: gau2 jyut6 hoi1 hok6
ex.en: School starts in September.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 gau2 jyut6 heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4
ex.en: We're traveling to Japan in September.

ex.r: gau2 jyut6 zung6 hou2 jit6
ex.en: It's still very hot in September.

words.note: 從來都唔/未 = never.

ex.r: ngo5 cung4 loi4 dou1 mei6 heoi3 gwo3 au1 zau1
ex.en: I've never been to Europe.

ex.r: keoi5 cung4 loi4 m4 sik6 laat6
ex.en: He never eats spicy food.

ex.r: keoi5 cung4 loi4 dou1 hou2 zeon2 si4
ex.en: She's always very punctual.

ex.r: gung1 hei2 nei5 min6 si5 sing4 gung1
ex.en: Congratulations on passing the interview!

ex.r: keoi5 pun4 saang1 ji3 hou2 sing4 gung1
ex.en: His business is very successful.

ex.r: ngo5 si3 zo2 saam1 ci3 sin1 sing4 gung1
ex.en: It took me three tries to get it to work.

words.note: 慢慢嚟 = take your time.

ex.r: nei5 gong2 maan6 di1 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3
ex.en: Could you speak a bit slower?

ex.r: di1 mong5 hou2 maan6
ex.en: The internet is really slow.

ex.r: zaa1 maan6 di1 laa1 hou2 ngai4 him2
ex.en: Drive slower, it's dangerous.

words.note: 刷牙 = brush teeth; 牙醫 = dentist.

ex.r: fan3 gaau3 cin4 gei3 dak1 caat3 ngaa4
ex.en: Remember to brush your teeth before bed.

ex.r: ngo5 zek3 ngaa4 hou2 tung3
ex.en: My tooth really hurts.

ex.r: ngo5 ting1 jat6 heoi3 tai2 ngaa4 ji1
ex.en: I'm going to the dentist tomorrow.

words.note: 出去 = to go out.

ex.r: ceng2 jap6 lai4 co5
ex.en: Please come in and have a seat.

ex.r: lok6 jyu5 laa3 faai3 di1 jap6 lai4
ex.en: It's raining, come inside quick!

ex.r: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 haang4 jap6 lai4
ex.en: He just walked in.

words.note: Measure word 本. 查字典 = look up in a dictionary.

ex.s: 呢個字點解？查吓字典啦。
ex.r: ni1 go3 zi6 dim2 gaai2 caa4 haa5 zi6 din2 laa1
ex.en: What does this word mean? Look it up in the dictionary.

ex.s: 我電話有個廣東話字典。
ex.r: ngo5 din6 waa2 jau5 go3 gwong2 dung1 waa2 zi6 din2
ex.en: I have a Cantonese dictionary on my phone.

ex.s: 你可唔可以借本字典俾我？
ex.r: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ze3 bun2 zi6 din2 bei2 ngo5
ex.en: Can you lend me a dictionary?

words.note: Measure word 架. 搭巴士 = take the bus.

ex.r: ngo5 jat6 jat6 daap3 baa1 si2 faan1 gung1
ex.en: I take the bus to work every day.

ex.r: gaa3 baa1 si2 gei2 si4 dou3 aa3
ex.en: When does the bus get here?

ex.r: baa1 si2 zaam6 hai2 bin1 dou6 aa3
ex.en: Where's the bus stop?

ex.r: di1 seoi2 bin3 sing4 bing1 laa3
ex.en: The water has turned into ice.

ex.r: keoi5 jau4 hok6 saang1 bin3 sing4 lou5 si1
ex.en: She went from student to teacher.

ex.r: go3 tin1 dat6 jin4 bin3 sing4 hak1 sik1
ex.en: The sky suddenly turned dark.

ex.r: sik6 do1 di1 coi3 deoi3 gin6 hong1 hou2
ex.en: Eat more vegetables, it's good for your health.

ex.r: zuk1 nei5 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1
ex.en: Wishing you good health!

ex.r: keoi5 baat3 sap6 seoi3 zung6 hou2 gin6 hong1
ex.en: He's eighty and still very healthy.

ex.r: nei5 di1 saam1 m4 hou2 baai2 hai2 dei6 haa2
ex.en: Don't leave your clothes on the floor.

ex.r: keoi5 m4 siu2 sam1 dit3 zo2 lok6 dei6 haa2
ex.en: He accidentally fell on the ground.

ex.r: ngo5 hai2 dei6 haa2 daai6 tong4 dang2 nei5
ex.en: I'll wait for you in the ground-floor lobby.

ex.r: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 hai2 dou6 wan2 gung1
ex.en: I've been looking for a job lately.

ex.r: ji4 gaa1 wan2 gung1 hou2 naan4
ex.en: It's hard to find a job these days.

ex.s: 佢畢業之後即刻去搵工。
ex.r: keoi5 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 zik1 hak1 heoi3 wan2 gung1
ex.en: Right after graduating, he started looking for work.

words.en: and so on; things like that
words.note: Often 之類嘅 + noun: 遮之類嘅嘢 = an umbrella or such.

ex.s: 我想買啲零食，薯片之類。
ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 di1 ling4 sik6 syu4 pin2 zi1 leoi6
ex.en: I want to buy some snacks, like chips.

ex.s: 佢鍾意游水、跑步之類嘅運動。
ex.r: keoi5 zung1 ji3 jau4 seoi2 paau2 bou6 zi1 leoi6 ge3 wan6 dung6
ex.en: She likes sports like swimming and running.

ex.r: daai3 ding6 ze1 zi1 leoi6 ge3 je5 laa1
ex.en: Bring an umbrella or something like that.

ex.r: sau2 sin1 nei5 jiu3 hoi1 go3 wu6 hau2
ex.en: First, you need to open an account.

ex.r: sau2 sin1 do1 ze6 daai6 gaa1 gam1 jat6 lai4
ex.en: First of all, thanks everyone for coming today.

ex.r: sau2 sin1 sai2 mai5 gan1 zyu6 bou1 faan6
ex.en: First wash the rice, then cook it.

words.en: to contact; to keep in touch

ex.r: jau5 me1 si6 zoi3 lyun4 lok3 laa1
ex.en: Let's be in touch if anything comes up.

ex.r: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hou2 noi6 mou5 lyun4 lok3 laa3
ex.en: I haven't been in touch with her for ages.

ex.r: ngo5 dim2 joeng2 lyun4 lok3 nei5 aa3
ex.en: How can I reach you?

ex.r: haa6 ci3 zoi3 lai4 laa1
ex.en: Come again next time!

ex.r: haa6 ci3 ngo5 ceng2 nei5
ex.en: Next time it's my treat.

ex.r: haa6 ci3 zou2 di1 waa6 ngo5 zi1
ex.en: Tell me earlier next time.

words.note: 認得 = recognize; 認錯 = admit a mistake.

ex.r: nei5 zung6 jing6 m4 jing6 dak1 ngo5 aa3
ex.en: Do you still recognize me?

ex.s: 佢剪咗頭髮，我認唔出佢。
ex.r: keoi5 zin2 zo2 tau4 faat3 ngo5 jing6 m4 ceot1 keoi5
ex.en: She cut her hair, I didn't recognize her.

ex.r: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 jing6 co3 laa3
ex.en: He finally admitted he was wrong.

words.note: Mandarin 明年.

ex.r: ngo5 haa6 nin2 soeng2 heoi3 hon4 gwok3
ex.en: I want to go to Korea next year.

ex.r: keoi5 haa6 nin2 bat1 jip6
ex.en: She graduates next year.

ex.r: haa6 nin2 zou1 gam1 jau6 gaa1
ex.en: The rent is going up again next year.

words.note: Goes before the verb; 咁滯 goes after it.

ex.r: ngo5 gei1 fu4 jat6 jat6 dou1 jam2 gaa3 fe1
ex.en: I drink coffee almost every day.

ex.r: gaan1 pou3 gei1 fu4 mou5 jan4
ex.en: The shop is almost empty.

ex.s: 我幾乎唔記得今日係佢生日。
ex.r: ngo5 gei1 fu4 m4 gei3 dak1 gam1 jat6 hai6 keoi5 saang1 jat6
ex.en: I almost forgot today is her birthday.

ex.r: ngo5 jau5 go3 hou2 siu1 sik1 waa6 nei5 zi1
ex.en: I have some good news to tell you!

ex.r: jau5 siu1 sik1 zau6 waa6 ngo5 zi1
ex.en: Let me know when you hear anything.

ex.s: 佢去咗英國之後冇晒消息。
ex.r: keoi5 heoi3 zo2 jing1 gwok3 zi1 hau6 mou5 saai3 siu1 sik1
ex.en: After he went to the UK, we never heard from him.

words.en: but then (unexpectedly); how would I know?
words.note: 點知… = 'who knew…, but then…'.

ex.s: 我以為佢會嚟，點知佢冇嚟。
ex.r: ngo5 ji5 wai4 keoi5 wui5 lai4 dim2 zi1 keoi5 mou5 lai4
ex.en: I thought he'd come, but he didn't.

ex.s: 出門口嗰陣好好天，點知落大雨。
ex.r: ceot1 mun4 hau2 go2 zan6 hou2 hou2 tin1 dim2 zi1 lok6 daai6 jyu5
ex.en: It was sunny when I left, but then it poured.

ex.r: ngo5 dim2 zi1 keoi5 heoi3 zo2 bin1 aa3
ex.en: How would I know where he went?

words.en: had better; it's best to; best

ex.r: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 zou2 di1 ceot1 mun4 hau2
ex.en: You'd better leave early.

ex.r: heoi3 zi1 cin4 zeoi3 hou2 daa2 go3 din6 waa2
ex.en: It's best to call before you go.

ex.r: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 pang4 jau5
ex.en: He's my best friend.

words.note: Goes after the number: 七點咁上下 = around seven.

ex.s: 去機場要一個鐘咁上下。
ex.r: heoi3 gei1 coeng4 jiu3 jat1 go3 zung1 gam3 soeng6 haa2
ex.en: It takes about an hour to get to the airport.

ex.r: ni1 gin6 saam1 loeng5 baak3 man1 gam3 soeng6 haa2
ex.en: This top is about two hundred dollars.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 cat1 dim2 gam3 soeng6 haa2 dou3
ex.en: We'll get there around seven.

words.note: Colloquial. 好寸 = arrogant, condescending.

ex.r: go2 go3 dim3 jyun4 gong2 je5 hou2 cyun3
ex.en: That shop assistant talks really rudely.

ex.r: m4 hou2 gam3 cyun3 laa1
ex.en: Don't be so cocky.

ex.r: keoi5 fuk1 ngo5 go3 seon3 sik1 hou2 cyun3
ex.en: Her reply to my message was really snarky.

ex.r: nei5 zik6 zip3 lai4 ngo5 uk1 kei2 laa1
ex.en: Just come straight to my place.

ex.r: jau5 man6 tai4 zik6 zip3 man6 ngo5
ex.en: If you have a question, ask me directly.

ex.r: ni1 baan1 gei1 zik6 zip3 fei1 dung1 ging1
ex.en: This flight goes direct to Tokyo.

words.note: Colloquial; for looks, food or behavior.

ex.r: ni1 zek3 cung4 hou2 wat6 dat6 aa3
ex.en: This bug is so gross!

ex.r: gin6 saam1 go3 ngaan4 sik1 hou2 wat6 dat6
ex.en: The color of that top is hideous.

ex.r: keoi5 sik6 je5 gam3 daai6 seng1 hou2 wat6 dat6
ex.en: He eats so loudly, it's gross.

ex.s: 你講得啱，呢度的確好貴。
ex.r: nei5 gong2 dak1 ngaam1 ni1 dou6 dik1 kok3 hou2 gwai3
ex.en: You're right, it really is expensive here.

ex.r: keoi5 dik1 kok3 hou2 lek1
ex.en: She really is talented.

ex.r: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 dik1 kok3 jau5 jung6
ex.en: This method really does work.

ex.r: nei5 jau5 mou5 me1 ji3 gin3 aa3
ex.en: Do you have any thoughts?

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 teng1 haa5 nei5 ge3 ji3 gin3
ex.en: I'd like to hear your opinion.

ex.s: 佢對我啲朋友好多意見。
ex.r: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 di1 pang4 jau5 hou2 do1 ji3 gin3
ex.en: She has lots of complaints about my friends.

ex.r: ngo5 ting1 jat6 min6 si5 hou2 gan2 zoeng1
ex.en: I have an interview tomorrow, I'm so nervous.

ex.r: m4 sai2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1 maan6 maan2 lai4
ex.en: No need to be so nervous, take it easy.

ex.s: 場波好緊張，最後一分鐘先入波。
ex.r: coeng4 bo1 hou2 gan2 zoeng1 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 fan1 zung1 sin1 jap6 bo1
ex.en: The game was tense, the goal only came in the last minute.

words.note: 一杯水 = a glass of water. Also a noun: 杯 = cup.

ex.r: m4 goi1 bei2 bui1 seoi2 ngo5
ex.en: A glass of water, please.

ex.r: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 jiu3 jam2 bui1 gaa3 fe1
ex.en: I need a cup of coffee in the morning.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jam2 bui1 je5 laa1
ex.en: Let's go grab a drink.

words.en: to take; to carry; to bring
words.note: Close to 攞. 拎走 = take away.

ex.r: bong1 ngo5 ling1 go3 doi2 aa1
ex.en: Could you carry my bag for me?

ex.r: gei3 dak1 ling1 maai4 so2 si4
ex.en: Remember to bring your keys too.

ex.r: nei5 hai6 mai6 ling1 zo2 ngo5 baa2 ze1 aa3
ex.en: Did you take my umbrella?

words.note: 記住 = keep in mind; 記低 = write down.

ex.r: gei3 zyu6 ting1 jat6 baat3 dim2 zaap6 hap6
ex.en: Remember, we meet at eight tomorrow.

ex.r: ngo5 gei3 m4 zyu6 gam3 do1 meng2
ex.en: I can't remember that many names.

ex.s: 你記低我個電話號碼啦。
ex.r: nei5 gei3 dai1 ngo5 go3 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5 laa1
ex.en: Write down my phone number.

words.note: Very common for voice messages on the phone.

ex.s: 我唔得閒打字，錄音俾你。
ex.r: ngo5 m4 dak1 haan4 daa2 zi6 luk6 jam1 bei2 nei5
ex.en: I'm too busy to type, I'll send you a voice message.

ex.r: soeng5 tong4 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 luk6 jam1 aa3
ex.en: Can I record the class?

ex.r: nei5 teng1 zo2 ngo5 go3 luk6 jam1 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Have you listened to my voice message?

words.note: 全世界 = the whole world.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 waan4 jau4 sai3 gaai3
ex.en: I want to travel around the world.

ex.s: 呢間係全世界最好食嘅餐廳！
ex.r: ni1 gaan1 hai6 cyun4 sai3 gaai3 zeoi3 hou2 sik6 ge3 caan1 teng1
